mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over a 3-month period signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over a 2-month period signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced economic output.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% over 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, typically leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase & UNRATE decrease in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over a 6-month period, coupled with a stable or increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals inflationary pressure without corresponding monetary tightening, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increase over 6 months & stable/increasing FEDFUNDS
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases over 6 months and FEDFUNDS is stable or increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 over a single month signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate increased economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over a 6-month period, coupled with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals robust economic growth and a strong labor market, typically leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase over 6 months & stable/decreasing UNRATE
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increases over 6 months and UNRATE is stable or decreasing.
